description: This file defines the IOnDeserialized interface and the DeserializationContext abstract class within the Orleans.Serialization namespace, related to deserialization notification mechanisms.

classes.name: DeserializationContext
classes.description: An abstract class representing the context during deserialization, providing access to services and runtime client information.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Method that notifies an object that it has been fully deserialized.
